Details 
 Edgewood hat is a classic ranch hat built for everyday wear with clean western style and a comfortable trucker fit. Designed as a breathable country hat, the Edgewood features a structured front with a large 3D horns logo that gives it a bold but simple look. The mesh back keeps this western hat cool and comfortable, making it a great choice for long days outside, travel, or daily wear.
 Built for durability and easy use, this ranch hat has the classic trucker shape that holds its form while still feeling lightweight. The adjustable snapback closure allows for a secure fit, while the breathable design makes it a dependable country hat for warm weather. Whether you are at the barn, on the road, or out for the day, the Edgewood is made to keep up.
 The simple western look makes this ranch hat easy to pair with your favorite Kimes Ranch jeans, tees, hoodies, or button downs. Designed for work, outdoors, and everyday life, the Edgewood is a western hat that delivers comfort, durability, and timeless ranch style.
 Fabric: Cotton Twill
 Fit: Adjustable Snapback | High-Profile | Flat Bill
 Details: Cotton Twill with 3D Embroidery
